description: Run an import: the SAME arguments as plan_import, plus its planHash and a clientRequestId (e.g. a UUID). Everything lands in ONE import batch. If anything changed since the plan (the rows, or the organization now answers differently) it returns planChanged with the new outcome and writes nothing. A large list can return done: false; the same call with the same arguments and clientRequestId continues where it stopped and never duplicates. clientRequestId identifies the batch: the same id continues it, a new id starts a new batch (still checked against planHash). With a container column, the answer repeats the placements and the stock groups. Every created item's history shows the connected user's name with "(via AI agent)"; the import appears in the app's import history (webUrl), where it can be undone. Requires the manager role.

clientRequestId.description: One id per import batch (e.g. a UUID); the same id continues a run that answered done: false

columns.description: One entry per cell position of a row, in the same order

header.description: The column's header as in the file

target.description: Import target (see the tool description), a field definition id, "field:<label>", or null to skip the column

fileName.description: The source file's name (shown in the app's import history), e.g. Inventar 2024.xlsx

keepOrder.description: Items are imported last row first by default, so the file's first row is the newest item and the app's list opens on it; true keeps the file order

planHash.description: The planHash plan_import returned for these arguments

rows.description: The data rows of the source file, cells as strings, header row left out. At most 1000 rows per call

separator.description: Path separator in category and location cells (default "/": "Fahrzeuge/Anhänger")

name: run_import

blockers.description: What run_import refuses until it is fixed. Empty = none

detail.description: What is wrong and how to fix it

kind.description: duplicateNameWithoutCode, duplicateCode, placementGroupTooLarge, duplicateUniqueValue, unknownField, ambiguousField, unknownTarget, duplicateTarget, noNameColumn, noCategoryColumn, rowTooWide, noRows, overCap

capacity.description: The plan's item allowance; null = no allowance

columnsNotImported.description: Mapped columns the organization's plan cannot import

done.description: false: the run stopped early; the same call with the same arguments and clientRequestId continues it

order.description: reversed (default for items: the first row becomes the newest item, so the app's list opens on it) or "file" (keepOrder)

placements.description: Only with a container column: per container, the single items packed into it and the stock counts that go into it

compartmentsToCreate.description: Compartments the import adds to it, in the file's order

existingItemId.description: Set when the container is an existing item

planChanged.description: run_import only: nothing was written, the plan changed

planHash.description: run_import takes it with the SAME arguments; it changes when the rows or the organization's answers change

problems.description: Every row that does not simply create an item cleanly: dropped values, skipped rows, updates of existing items

code.description: The importer's issue code, e.g. invalidValue (the value is dropped), missingCategory (row skipped), containerNotFound (the row imports unplaced)

placesIntoRow.description: A stock article's row: the 1-based row of the item it adds its count to

refused.description: Set when the call was refused and nothing was written: tooManyRows, tooManyColumns, blockers, batchUndone

stockGroups.description: Only with a container column: each stock article whose rows (one per place, same name and code) become ONE stock item — its total, the pieces at home and per place

homePieces.description: Pieces at the item's home location

row.description: 1-based position of the row that defines the item

summary.description: Rows by outcome: create / update / skip / place (adds stock in a place to another row's item, see stockGroups), and by status: ok / warnings (the row imports, a value is dropped) / errors (the row is skipped)

placed.description: Rows that added stock in a place to another row's item

toCreate.description: What the import itself would create by name — usually a typo when the structure was created first

compartments.description: «Container › compartment» per compartment the import adds

webUrl.description: The app's import history, where the import can also be undone

title: Run an import
